name: openai-images
description: OpenAI Images: generate and edit images with GPT Image and DALL·E models, saved to a local folder (paid)

nodes.title: List models
nodes.description: List the models this API key can use (image models start with gpt-image, chatgpt-image or dall-e)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Generate image
nodes.description: Generate images from a text prompt (paid). Images are saved to $OPENAI_IMAGES_OUTPUT_DIR; the result lists saved_files

prompt.description: What to generate (max 32000 characters for GPT Image, 4000 for dall-e-3)

model.description: Model, e.g. gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1-mini, chatgpt-image-latest (dall-e-3 / dall-e-2 for generations only)

n.description: Number of images (default 1; dall-e-3 supports only 1)

size.description: auto (default), 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536; gpt-image-2 models also take WIDTHxHEIGHT (multiples of 16, max 3840x2160)

quality.description: auto (default); low/medium/high for GPT Image; xhigh/max only on 2.5 models; standard/hd for dall-e-3. Higher quality costs more

background.description: transparent needs output_format png or webp (GPT Image only)

output_format.description: Output format (GPT Image only, default png)

moderation.description: Content moderation level (GPT Image only, default auto)

safety_identifier.description: Stable hashed id of your end user, for OpenAI abuse monitoring (max 128 characters)

response_format.description: dall-e models only (GPT Image always returns base64); URLs expire after 60 minutes

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Edit image
nodes.description: Edit an image (or create a variation of it) from a prompt, optionally limited to a transparent-mask area (paid). Upload: https URL or a file inside $OPENAI_IMAGES_UPLOAD_DIR

image.description: Image to edit (png, webp or jpg, under 50 MB) (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

mask.description: PNG with the same size as image; fully transparent areas are edited (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

model.description: Model, e.g. gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1-mini, chatgpt-image-latest (dall-e-3 / dall-e-2 for generations only)

n.description: Number of images (default 1; dall-e-3 supports only 1)

size.description: auto (default), 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536; gpt-image-2 models also take WIDTHxHEIGHT (multiples of 16, max 3840x2160)

quality.description: auto (default); low/medium/high for GPT Image; xhigh/max only on 2.5 models; standard/hd for dall-e-3. Higher quality costs more

background.description: transparent needs output_format png or webp (GPT Image only)

output_format.description: Output format (GPT Image only, default png)

moderation.description: Content moderation level (GPT Image only, default auto)

safety_identifier.description: Stable hashed id of your end user, for OpenAI abuse monitoring (max 128 characters)

input_fidelity.description: How closely to keep faces and details of the input (gpt-image-1.5; omit for gpt-image-2)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
